# Security Policy

This repository is a curated dataset and static documentation. It does not install runtime dependencies.

Report security issues through GitHub Security Advisories on https://github.com/Supersynergy/awesome-codedesign or through the Supersynergy Gitea issue tracker at https://git.marketdeck.io/Supersynergy/awesome-codedesign.

Do not paste tokens, private URLs, or proprietary source dumps into issues.
